hook_text: Two rooms, nine tiles and sixteen tiles. Push them together.
clip_script: What does not work: adding rooms. One room of nine tiles has side three; another of sixteen has side four. Push the two rooms together and you have twenty-five tiles, which happens to be a perfect square with side five — but five is not three plus four. The side of the combined room is not the sum of the sides, because the tiles rearrange into a new square. The square root of a sum is not the sum of the square roots, and here it is on the floor.
visual_style: A 3-by-3 tiled square and a 4-by-4 tiled square sliding together and the tiles rearranging into a 5-by-5 square; 3 + 4 crossed out, 5 stamped
call_to_action: Open the full session to master powers, roots and the order of operations together.
